parameters.name: Open
parameters.description: Opens the Glass Door, when set to 1. Closes it, when set to 0.

parameters.name: Lock
parameters.description: Locks the Glass Door, when set to 1. Unlocks it, when set to 0.

parameters.name: On
parameters.description: Turns the Glass Door on, when set to 1. Turns it off, when set to 0.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: When set to 0 console on the door opens/closes door. When set to 1 console sets/resets Setting but does not affect door.

parameters.name: Setting
parameters.description: Desired state, mostly usefull for Logic based control when Mode is 1.

outputs.name: Power
outputs.description: Returns whether the Glass Door is turned on and receives power. (0 for no, 1 for yes)

outputs.name: Open
outputs.description: Returns whether the Glass Door is open. (0 for no, 1 for yes)

outputs.name: Lock
outputs.description: Returns whether the Glass Door is locked. (0 for no, 1 for yes)

outputs.name: On
outputs.description: Returns whether the Glass Door is turned on. (0 for no, 1 for yes)

outputs.name: Mode
outputs.description: Return mode, 0 for default, 1 for logic based control

outputs.name: Setting
outputs.description: Returns desired state of the door. (0 for close, 1 for open) When Mode = 1

outputs.name: RequiredPower
outputs.description: Returns the current amount of power, required by the Glass Door, in watts.
